text: Electrical Engineering (EE) is an engineering discipline based on electromagnetism and circuit theory, which studies power systems, electronic devices, electrical control and energy conversion. Its core covers the entire chain of "power generation - transmission - distribution - consumption", as well as the design and development of electronic components and automation systems. It is the "nerves and blood vessels" of modern industry - from small chip circuits to large cross-regional power grids, all require the support of electrical engineering technology.
